title: Recycling carload charge change

informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Accept a carload

The site accepts one carload of mixed recyclables. Carloads that arrive after the change date pay 8 dollars. Today the charge is 5 dollars.

## Publish hours

The site publishes its open hours. This change does not alter the hours.

# Data Resources

## Site

The site records the address and the open hours.

# Constraints

## New carload charge

A carload that arrives after the change date pays 8 dollars. The source text does not say what happens to a punch card that was sold before the change.

alternatives.label: A punch card sold before the change still admits one carload.
A punch card sold before the change is void, and the driver pays the new charge at the gate.
